description: Ask for a refund for your user, exactly as previewed with preview_refund: pass the same request_id, preview_id and amount, and your user's reason (the preview's reason_category is used). It can't be undone. On the refund_now path the money is refunded right away and the order is canceled (also for a partial refund); refund.refunded_amount and refund.refund_id (the refund's reference) say what was refunded. On the seller_decides path the request goes to the seller (refund.seller_respond_by); the order doesn't complete on its own meanwhile, and check_request with the request_id shows its progress (refund). When the seller asks for the item back, the status is return_requested, refund.stage is awaiting_return and refund.return says where to send it and by when; after your user ships it, pass the tracking number with submit_return_shipment. Needs your user's Egonex account connected to you with permission to act for them (egonex.write), and that account must be the order's buyer: without such a connection (none, or a read-only one), nothing is done and the result is an error ending in (connection_required); when the connected account isn't the order's buyer, nothing is done (not_found). Without a connection, this is done on Egonex, in your user's chat with the seller. At most 5 calls a minute per connected account (slow_down). Nothing is requested when the preview expired (preview_expired) or isn't for this request, order and account (preview_not_found), when amount isn't the preview's (preview_mismatch), or when the seller marked the order delivered since the preview (preview_outdated: preview again and show your user the new amounts). Calling it again with the same preview_id returns the same refund request. If the result is refund_error, Egonex couldn't confirm the outcome and the refund may already have gone through: call it again with the same request_id, preview_id and amount, also after the preview's 15 minutes or after the seller marked the order delivered. A refund that went through is then recorded and returned (nothing is refunded twice); if none went through, the request is made as previewed, or refused with preview_outdated when the order changed. Egonex also records such a refund on its own, and a different refund already at the payment processor stops the request (refund_on_hold). Photos can't be attached here. Errors end with their code in parentheses. Only call this after your user saw the preview's amounts and deductions and asked for the refund.

amount.description: The amount you passed to preview_refund, in USD.

preview_id.description: preview_id from preview_refund for this request (it lasts 15 minutes).

reason.description: Why your user wants the refund, in their words, up to 1000 characters. The seller sees it, and so do Egonex members if they review it.

request_id.description: The id returned by request_order (check_request shows the order it led to).

name: request_refund

order.description: The order this request led to: made with pay_order, or placed by your user in the chat after confirming. Times are given only where they matter for the status.

accept_by.description: waiting_for_seller, or paid before the seller accepted: the seller has to accept by then (RFC 3339).

auto_confirm_at.description: delivered: the order completes on its own then, unless a refund is requested before (RFC 3339).

deliver_by.description: paid: the seller has to deliver by then (RFC 3339).

pay_by.description: ready_to_pay: the order closes if nobody pays by then (RFC 3339).

quantity.description: How many units at the listed price (items, hours, nights...); absent when the order doesn't record one, such as an older order or a total the seller quoted.

refunded_amount.description: refunded or completed: what was refunded to your user.

return_confirm_by.description: return_delivered: the seller has to confirm receipt by then; after that the refund goes ahead on its own (RFC 3339).

return_ship_by.description: return_requested: your user has to ship the item back by then, or the refund request closes without a refund (RFC 3339). The return address is only on the order on Egonex.

ship_to.description: An order that ships, once it is paid: the area it ships to (the name and street are never returned). pay_order can't change it; your user tells the seller in the Egonex chat.

title.description: What was ordered: the order's title, as on the order card.

refund.description: A refund request for the order.

amount.description: The amount requested, USD (items and shipping, before sales tax; for a physical item returned because your user changed their mind, at most the item price).

decided_at.description: refunded / not_refunded: when it was decided (RFC 3339).

decided_by.description: refunded / not_refunded: who decided: before_delivery (refunded right away), seller_agreed, seller_timeout (the seller didn't answer), return_received (the seller confirmed the returned item), return_auto (refunded automatically after the return was delivered), return_not_sent (no refund: the item wasn't shipped back in time), vote (Egonex members) or manual (Egonex).

refund_id.description: refunded: the refund's reference with the payment processor (a receipt).

refund_status.description: refunded: where the refund is with the payment processor: pending, succeeded, failed...

refunded_amount.description: refunded: what your user gets back, USD (sales tax included).

return.description: When the seller asked for the item back: where and by when to send it, and the return parcel.

carrier_name.description: The carrier's name when carrier is other.

confirm_by.description: The seller confirms receipt by then, or the refund goes through automatically (RFC 3339).

delivery_deadline.description: A parcel not delivered by then goes to Egonex (RFC 3339).

label.description: The prepaid return label the seller provided (when the seller pays the shipping).

display_url.description: A short-lived link to the label: show or download it now, don't keep it.

method.description: ship: the item goes back by mail.

problem_note.description: What the seller said when they reported a problem with the returned item.

ship_by.description: Ship it and pass the tracking number with submit_return_shipment by then, or the request closes with no refund (RFC 3339).

shipment_status.description: Where the return parcel is, as the carrier reports it.

shipped_at.description: When the tracking number was passed (RFC 3339).

shipping_paid_by.description: Who pays the return shipping: seller (with the prepaid label in label) or buyer.

seller_respond_by.description: awaiting_seller: the seller answers by then (RFC 3339).

stage.description: awaiting_seller (the seller has until seller_respond_by), awaiting_return (your user ships the item back by return.ship_by), return_in_transit, return_delivered (the seller confirms receipt by return.confirm_by), jury_voting (Egonex members vote until vote_by), egonex_review (Egonex decides), refunded or not_refunded.

vote_by.description: jury_voting: the members vote by then (RFC 3339).

status.description: Where the order stands now, as check_request reports it: pending (waiting for your user to confirm or decline; nothing has happened yet), declined (your user chose not to go ahead), expired (nobody acted within 7 days; the link no longer works), listing_unavailable (the listing isn't for sale anymore (taken down or sold out), so the request can't go ahead), message_sent (messages only: the message was sent to the seller as your user), awaiting_order (orders only: your user confirmed and the chat is open, but they haven't placed the order yet), payment_in_progress (orders only: a payment is being processed), payment_failed (orders only: a pay_order payment didn't go through; nothing was charged and the order can still be paid), waiting_for_seller (orders only: the order was sent to the seller, who hasn't accepted yet; nothing has been charged), ready_to_pay (orders only: the order is waiting to be paid (pay_order again, or your user pays on Egonex)), paid (orders only: paid; waiting for the seller to deliver), delivered (orders only: the seller marked it delivered; waiting for your user to confirm receipt), refund_requested (orders only: your user asked for a refund; Egonex is handling it), return_requested (orders only: the item has to go back for the refund: your user ships it by order.return_ship_by and adds the tracking number on Egonex), return_in_transit (orders only: the item is on its way back; the refund follows once it arrives and the seller confirms), return_delivered (orders only: the returned item arrived; waiting for the seller to confirm receipt, then the refund follows), completed (orders only: the order is complete), refund_pending (orders only: canceled after payment; the refund hasn't gone through yet), refunded (orders only: canceled after payment; your user was refunded), closed_unpaid (orders only: the order closed before anything was charged (close_reason says why)).

title: Ask for a refund for your user
